mapper.sql: id, provider_id, provider_line_id, public_name, operator_name, route_type, active, source_updated_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transit_line ( id, provider_id, provider_line_id, public_name, operator_name, route_type, active, source_updated_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{providerId}, #{providerLineId}, #{publicName}, #{operatorName}, #{routeType}, #{active}, #{sourceUpdatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (provider_id, provider_line_id) DO UPDATE SET public_name = EXCLUDED.public_name, operator_name = EXCLUDED.operator_name, route_type = EXCLUDED.route_type, active = EXCLUDED.active, source_updated_at = EXCLUDED.source_updated_at, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, provider_id, provider_line_id, public_name, operator_name, route_type, active, source_updated_at, created_at, updated_at FROM transit_line WHERE provider_id = #{providerId} AND active = TRUE AND public_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN public_name = #{query} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CHAR_LENGTH(public_name), public_name LIMIT #{limit}
